name: business-logic-graph
description: Maintain progressively verified business logic in independent data Git repositories, with master baselines and branch overlays.

interface.longDescription: Keeps business graphs in independent data Git repositories, outside target source repositories. It composes master baselines and worktree-specific branch overlays, loads bounded context, verifies source/config/tests, and gates development plans on current evidence.
defaultPrompt: Use the repository's Business Logic Graph to locate and verify the business area related to my request before proposing a development plan.
Explain this business flow from the BLG, verify uncertain claims against the repository, and record the verified result.
Validate the BLG and report stale, inferred, conflicting, or insufficiently evidenced business claims.
